next.reason: 1985 GR5: a file may be opened INPUT, OUTPUT, EXTEND and I-O in one run unit, and each re-OPEN 'must be preceded by the execution of a CLOSE statement, without the REEL, UNIT, or LOCK phrase'. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR4 sets any of the four modes; GR2 'The file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall not be open' (41, §2023:9.1.13.7 GR1, as in 1985); only a CLOSE 'without the UNIT phrase' leaves open mode (§2023:14.9.6.4 GR8), with REEL and UNIT equivalent (§2023:14.9.6.3 SR2). The LOCK exclusion has no 2023 counterpart because the 2023 CLOSE format has no LOCK phrase; that removal belongs to the CLOSE format record. Every reopen sequence both editions accept behaves the same.
